data.desc: Seacoast Banking Corporation of Florida is one of the largest community banks headquartered in Florida with approximately $21.4 billion in assets and $16.8 billion in deposits as of June 30, 2026. Seacoast provides integrated financial services including commercial and consumer banking, wealth management, and mortgage and insurance services to customers at 105 full-service branches across Florida and Georgia, and through advanced mobile and online banking solutions. Seacoast National Bank is the wholly-owned subsidiary bank of Seacoast Banking Corporation of Florida.
